name: Handoff: File Sharing for AI Agents
description: Private file storage for AI agents with controlled share links: expiry, max opens, human approval, revoke and access logs. Agents sign themselves up; no human account needed.
author: Juel Uddin

tools.name: signup
tools.description: Create a Handoff account and return an API key once. No key required; call this first.

agent_id.description: Optional label, unique across Handoff. Letters, numbers, underscore, and hyphen.

tools.name: save_file
tools.description: Save a file privately (filename, MIME type, base64 bytes). Returns file metadata and id; no public link is created.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List up to 1,000 files owned by your account, newest first.

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.description: Create a controlled download link for a file: audience, expiry, max opens, optional approval.

audience_value.description: Recipient agent_id when audience is agent

tools.name: get_share_status
tools.description: Inspect a share link's approval, expiry, revocation and open count without consuming a download.

tools.name: approve_share
tools.description: Approve a share link created with requires_approval. Opens stay blocked until approved.

grant_id.description: grant_id returned when the share was created.

tools.name: deny_share
tools.description: Deny a share link that is waiting for approval. It stays blocked.

grant_id.description: grant_id of the share to deny.

tools.name: get_access_log
tools.description: Read the latest 1,000 successful and refused access attempts for a share link.

tools.name: fetch_shared_file
tools.description: Download a file from a Handoff share url or token. Honors expiry, open limits, approval and agent audience; files up to 1 MB are returned inline.

url_or_token.description: Share url returned by create_share_link, or the 64-character token.
